study: V3 = V2 + (1) sqrt(t) gap branch + (2) beta cap + (3) median-of-cells step aggregation
registered: 2026-10-15, before any V3 code was written or run
exposure_disclosure: Change 1 and 2 were motivated by an exploratory back-of-envelope calculation on the same proxies (2026-10-14/15): sqrt(t) for CK2 gave about -0.02 pp at delta 0.4; capping beta at 1.2 gave MAE 0.224 vs 0.216. Results for those two are therefore exposed, not blind.
Change 3 is motivated only by external data (ESSL1 16S pack); it has not been evaluated on this pack before registration.
Proxies are post-checkup full charges + eps; they are not hidden truth.

1_sqrt_gap_branch.trigger: the last visible deep step program before CK_k (cut at CK_k 00:00) ends more than G = 10 days before CK_k, and an anchor after CK_(k-1) is visible
1_sqrt_gap_branch.rule: Q_hat = Q_fc(anchor k-1) + eps - a * (sqrt(t_k) - sqrt(t_(k-1))); t = days since CK0 date; a = least-squares slope through origin of loss_j = 100.41 - (Q_fc(anchor j) + eps) on sqrt(t_j) over all visible anchors j = 1..k-1
1_sqrt_gap_branch.rationale: the step signal cannot see the uncovered period; our pack fades calendar-like (p about 0.44), unlike the cycling external data (p 0.56-1.09)
1_sqrt_gap_branch.applies_to: any checkup meeting the trigger; with the released data only CK2 is expected to trigger (segment 3 missing)

2_beta_cap.rule: beta_used = min(beta_a4, 1.2) in the phase-matched branch; beta0 = 1, tau = 1 Ah^2 unchanged
2_beta_cap.rationale: external packs give beta 1.1-1.2 within 0-8 % fade; fixed 1.3 lost to beta = 1 on 13/14 external series

3_median_aggregation.rule: replace the 4-cell mean by the 4-cell median (mean of the middle two) both for discharge step programs (step_mean) and for the A4 charge-direction step-to-top distance used for beta
3_median_aggregation.rationale: ESSL1 pack: median R2 0.99 vs mean 0.89 because single cells mis-detect the step

evaluation: same harness as V2: predictions for CK_k use load_dataset(until=CK_k) only; proxies P_k = Q_fc,k(full data) + eps0 + delta, delta in {0, 0.4, 0.8}; six step-detection variants; A4 smoothing 2 Ah (1 and 3 Ah reported)

gates.K1_causality: replacing every operation row after the CK_k cut with noise leaves all V3 predictions bit-identical
gates.K2_proxy: V3 MAE < V2 MAE at all three deltas, and V3 MAX <= V2 MAX
gates.K3_eps_scope: CK3-CK7 MAE (eps-independent part) of V3 <= V2 + 0.02 pp; CK2 error reported at all three deltas because the sqrt branch is eps-dependent
gates.K4_robust: V3 MAE < V2 MAE (delta 0.4) on >= 5 of 6 step variants, and every sensitivity setting keeps V3 MAE < V2 MAE
gates.K5_no_large_regression: no single checkup's |error| increases by more than 0.15 pp versus V2 (delta 0.4, main step)

decision_rule: V3 is called a candidate only if K1-K5 all pass; otherwise each change is reported by its ablation, and nothing is wired into my_model in this study
